49600.meaning1: flowing along the stream of being; following the current of existence

examples.text: tesaṃ phassaparetānaṃ, bhavasot'ānusārinaṃ, kummaggapaṭipannānaṃ, ārā saṃyojanakkhayo.
tesu ussukkajātesu, bhavasot'ānusārisu, ke'dha taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu, ke lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.

49601.meaning1: affection for being; love for sensual existence

examples.text: tassa bhavānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhav'ajjhosānaṃ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.

49602.meaning2: gratification in being; satisfaction in existence

49603.meaning1: liberation from being; freedom from existence

49605.grammar: masc, nom sg of bhavant, irreg

examples.text: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.
puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti. veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ayaṃ bhavan'ti.

49606.grammar: masc, nom sg of bhavant, irreg

examples.text: kim'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo āha puna bhavaṃ gotamo bravitū'ti
atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evam'āha, aham'pi kho, brāhmaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmī'ti.

49607.grammar: imp 2nd pl of bhavatu, irreg form of bhavatha, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

49608.meaning1: any state of existence; repeated existence
49608.commentary: (SNPa) bhav'ābhavesū'ti kāmabhav'ādīsu. atha vā bhav'ābhavesū'ti bhavabhavesu, punappunabhavesū'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yass'ūbhay'ante paṇidh'īdha n'atthi, bhav'ābhavāya idha vā huraṃ vā, nivesanā tassa na santi keci, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ.
vidvā ca yo vedagū naro idha, bhav'ābhave saṅgam'imaṃ visajja, so vītataṇho anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaranti brūmī'ti.

49609.meaning1: delighting in existence; loving life; very happy with life

examples.text: ye tuyha chandena vasena vattino, narā ca nārī ca anubhonti yaṃ sukhaṃ, aviddasū māravas'ānuvattino, bhav'ābhinandī tava citta sāvakā'ti.
tvaññ'eva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo, tvaṃ khattiyo rājadasī karosi, vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.

49611.grammar: imp, reflx 1st pl of bhavatu, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: tav'eva hetū asurā bhavāmase, tvaṃmūlakaṃ nerayikā bhavāmase, atho tiracchānagatā'pi ekadā, petattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.

49612.meaning1: enjoying being; taking pleasure in existence; fond of life

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke? bhav'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati n'ādhimuccati.

49613.meaning1: effluent of becoming; effluent of being
49613.commentary: (MNa) bhav'āsavo'ti rup'ārūpabhave chandarāgo, jhānanikanti ca sassat'ucchedadiṭṭhisahagatā. evaṃ diṭṭh'āsavopi bhav'āsave eva samodhānaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, āsavā, kām'āsavo, bhav'āsavo, avijj'āsavo.
tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kām'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati bhav'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati avijj'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati

49614.meaning1: be!; please be!; you must be!

examples.text: kaṅkhī vecikicchī āgamaṃ, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tes'antakaro bhavāhi pañhe me puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākarohi me.
sahassakaṇḍaṃ satabheṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayaṃ, satasahassaniyyūhā, byamhe pātubhaviṃsu me.

49616.meaning1: there should be; it must be; it should exist

examples.text: yassa siyā āpatti, so āvikareyya, asantiyā āpattiyā tuṇhī bhavitabbaṃ, tuṇhībhāvena kho pan'āyasmante parisuddhā'ti vedissāmi.
so, bhariyaṃ me nissāya bhayena uppannena bhavitabban'ti cintetvā rañño āṇaṃ paṭibāhituṃ asakkonto gantvā rājānaṃ vanditvā aṭṭhāsi
rājā arahasi bhavituṃ, cakkavattī rath'esabho, cāturanto vijitāvī, jambusaṇḍassa issaro.
kataññunā me bhavituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti ekaṃ satasahassaṃ gāhāpetvā cūḷaseṭṭhissa samīpaṃ gato

49620.meaning1: having been; having become; having existed

examples.text: daḍḍhe ca kho pana bhagavato sarīre antalikkhā udakadhārā pātubhavitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
bhavissan'ti hoti, itthaṃ bhavissan'ti hoti, evaṃ bhavissan'ti hoti, aññathā bhavissan'ti hoti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhūpāyati.
ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabban'ti.
ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabbaṃ, yassa bhavissati, so harissatī'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

49624.commentary: (THIa) na puno edisakaṃ bhavissatī'ti ito paraṃ evarūpaṃ anācāracaraṇaṃ na bhavissati, na karissāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa ca viramāsi tāva'd'e, rāgo tattha khamāpayī ca naṃ, sotthi siyā brahmacārinī, na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati.

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, maññitam'etaṃ, ayam'aham'asmī'ti maññitam'etaṃ, bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ, na bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ, rūpī bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ
bhavissan'ti hoti, itthaṃ bhavissan'ti hoti, evaṃ bhavissan'ti hoti, aññathā bhavissan'ti hoti. imāni aṭṭhārasa taṇhāvicaritāni ajjhattikassa upādāya.

49631.commentary: (SNPa) bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisan'ti attano bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca kīdisaṃ vadasī'ti.

examples.text: etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavataṃ nu jīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.

49632.meaning1: could be; should be; will be

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi, yāthāvadassīhi jit'indriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

49633.commentary: (DNa) tattha katamā bhav'esanā? yo bhavesu bhavacchando bhav'ajjhosānaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati bhav'esanā'ti evaṃ vutto bhavagavesanarāgo bhav'esanā nāma.

49635.meaning1: enjoyed the state; successfully attained existence
49635.commentary: (THa) mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito'ti manuss'attabhāvo'pi mayā tādisena kusalakammunā samavāyena abhirādhito sādhito adhigato. kāṇakacchap'opama-suttam'ettha udāharitabbaṃ.

examples.text: mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito, saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu, n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitaṃ.

atha kho, bhikkhave, vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca, he je kāḷī'ti. kiṃ, ayye'ti? kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti. no vata re kiñci, pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā bhākuṭiṃ akāsi.

atha kho, bhikkhave, vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca, he je kāḷī'ti. kiṃ, ayye'ti? kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti. no vata re kiñci, pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā bhākuṭiṃ akāsi.

49641.commentary: (VINa) bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko viyā'ti okkhittacakkhutāya bhakuṭiṃ katvā saṅkuṭitamukho kupito viya vicaratī'ti maññamānā vadanti.

49642.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.3) dve bhāgā… dve tulā (VINa) dve bhāgā'ti dve koṭṭhāsā.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, yo c'āyaṃ kāmavitakko yo ca byāpādavitakko yo ca vihiṃsāvitakko, imaṃ ekaṃ bhāgam'akāsiṃ. yo c'āyaṃ nekkhammavitakko yo ca abyāpādavitakko yo ca avihiṃsāvitakko, imaṃ dutiyaṃ bhāgam'akāsiṃ.

49646.commentary: (SNa) bhāgaso pavibhajan'ti satipaṭṭhān'ādi-koṭṭhāsa-vasena dhammaṃ vibhajantaṃ. pavibhajjā'ti vā pāṭho, aṅgapaccaṅga-koṭṭhāsa-vasena vibhajitvā vibhajitvā passathā'ti attho.

examples.text: ummaggapathaṃ mārassa abhibhuyya, carati pabhijja khilāni, taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃ bhāgaso pavibhajaṃ.

49647.meaning1: having a part (in); sharing (in); partaking (in); profiting (from)

examples.text: bahum'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, na takkaro hoti naro pamatto, gopo'va gāvo gaṇayaṃ paresaṃ, na bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.

bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, pāpima, dūsī nāma māro ahosiṃ, tassa me kāḷī nāma bhaginī. tassā tvaṃ putto. so me tvaṃ bhāgineyyo ahosi. tena kho pana, pāpima, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
rājā'pi amacce pakkosāpetvā, mayhaṃ bhāgineyyo'pi imassa rajjassa sāmiko'va, dhītaraṃ etass'eva datvā abhisekam'assa karomī'ti.

49660.commentary: (VINa) udake pana bhājanagatan'ti udakadullabhakāle udakamaṇik'ādīsu bhājanesu saṅgopetvā ṭhapitaṃ. taṃ yasmiṃ bhājane ṭhapitaṃ hoti, taṃ bhājanaṃ āviñchitvā vā chiddaṃ katvā vā tattha pokkharaṇītaḷākesu ca attano bhājanaṃ pavesetvā gaṇhantassa sappitelesu vuttanayena vinicchayo veditabbo.
